title: Habit-tracking app first launch
context: A free habit-tracking mobile app, competing with many similar apps in the stores.

variants.seed_text:
# First launch
Screen 1: pick a habit (drink water, read, walk) or type your own. Screen 2: choose a reminder time. Done: you're on the home screen with your first habit. Account optional (to sync later). No ads; a 3.99 € one-time upgrade unlocks unlimited habits and stats.

# First launch
The app asks for access to contacts, location, microphone, photos and calendar before showing anything. Then a mandatory account (phone number and email verification), a 12-question survey, and a full-screen video ad. Then a paywall: 'Start your 3-day free trial, then 59.99 €/week'. Closing the paywall shows another ad.

source: synthetic sanity case: the difference is planted and obvious by design
